explanation: This norm-2.30 vector combines a clinical-caution contrast projected into shared LoRA output directions with a correction that opposes the adapter’s estimated residual drift across several layers. It also includes a gate/up projection estimate and a smaller attention correction derived from contrasts between medical and general question vocabulary. Applied after block 12 (zero-based), it closed 38.32% of the medical loss gap and 35.62% of the general loss gap on the practice batch, the best tested result on both.
